header.name: Bo-Yu Chen
header.tagline: Researcher and builder working across music AI, creative tools, musical interfaces, and human–computer interaction.

education.degree: M.S. in Networking and Multimedia (Dept. of CSIE)
description: **Master's Thesis:** *FlueBricks: A Modular Toolkit for Interactive Flute-like Instrument Systems* [[C1]] (Advisor: [[person:lung-pan-cheng]])
**Thesis Honors:** Winner of **TAICHI 2026 Master's Thesis Honorable Mention Award** {{Top 16.6%}}

education.school: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST)

description: **Architecting Rytho**, a local-first creative workspace that enables AI agents to listen to, understand, search for, and create music alongside people.
**Led R&D on LLM-driven music agents**, developing conversational feedback agents for music production and reasoning systems for chord analysis. [[W1]] [[W2]]
**Managed engineering teams for government R&D projects** (TAICCA, Taipei City) and **[TMC-CL1](https://tmccl1.tmccloud.taipei/)**, a web music interface commissioned by Taipei Music Center.

**Architected interactive web audio interfaces and networked performance systems**, developing a vocal sampler for Vocal Asia (Japan) [[A2]] and a p5.js/Node.js WebSocket engine bridging mobile audiences to Max/MSP stage synthesis [[A4]].
**Developed a web demo showcasing Taiwanese electronic music** in collaboration with electronic music artists for MIDEM (Cannes, France). [[A3]]

researchExperience.company: Computational Physicality Lab, National Taiwan University
description: **Designed FlueBricks**, a modular physical-computing toolkit enabling acoustic replication and customizable design of flute-like instruments as Master's thesis research. [[C1]]
**Engineered parametric CAD assemblies in Fusion 360** for digital fabrication, and conducted user evaluations across musician skill levels to validate expressive playability.

researchExperience.company: Creative AI Lab, Sony Group Corporation
description: **Developed DJTransGAN**, the first generative model for automated cross-track DJ transitions using DDSP and GANs. [[C2]]

**Open-sourced [DJtransGAN](https://github.com/ChenPaulYu/DJtransGAN) and its [data-generation pipeline](https://github.com/ChenPaulYu/DJtransGAN-dg-pipeline)**, earning **120+ GitHub stars** and community interest.

researchExperience.company: Music and AI Lab, Academia Sinica
description: **Pioneered loop-based music AI research** spanning compatibility assessment, generation, and benchmarking. [[C3]] [[C4]] [[C5]]
**Mentored 5+ junior researchers** and **co-authored 5 papers** on music AI.
Taught generative AI art (GANs, Stable Diffusion workflows) and physical computing with Arduino to creative practitioners.
Taught algorithms and C++/JS to K-12 students; coached high school students for the APCS examination.
